purpose: Bounded real-data follow-up to determine whether a stronger, canonical Stage-A adapter can move Falcon behavior after the rejected 8-step pilot. This is not a deployable or promoted checkpoint.
hypothesis: Increasing the update budget, LoRA capacity, learning rate, and target coverage should produce measurable adapter-on versus stock movement without reading the frozen final holdout.

execution.precision: plain FP16 LoRA; no QLoRA on P100; HF evaluation used fp32 on sm_60

data.public_data_policy: MCQA built from train splits only; no final holdout was read
data.frozen_gate: DEFERRED; no selected system prompt and the final holdout was intentionally excluded

training_result.checkpoint_selection: step 16 selected by lowest fast-dev eval loss; steps 8, 12, and 16 were complete and persisted
training_result.checkpoint_persistence: PASS; step-8 and step-16 resumable states uploaded to Kaggle Dataset toheebogunade/jamii-afya-falcon-production-checkpoints
training_result.promotion: not attempted; pilot explicitly forbids promotion

mechanical_quality_rubric.rubric_source: quality fields embedded in development/validation battery; not the frozen final gate

generation_behavior.qualitative_observation: The adapter changed token sequences but retained pervasive malformed Kiswahili, weak clinical dispositions, and failure to express the safety/refusal requirements. Movement was real but not useful quality improvement.

diagnosis.pipeline_movement: PASS; the canonical configuration moved 12/16 held-out development/validation generations, improved fast-dev SFT loss by 2.9%, and improved the tiny dev MCQA slice 40% to 60% (acc_norm 80% to 100%).
diagnosis.quality_result: FAIL; no gain on the mechanical generation rubric and the raw outputs remained malformed/unsafe-quality, especially in Kiswahili.
diagnosis.primary_next_diagnosis: data/teacher-answer quality and base-model/runtime capability need diagnosis before scaling; optimizer/LoRA attachment is no longer the leading explanation for unchanged behavior.
not_authorized: GGUF export as a submission candidate
diagnosis.next_action: FOLLOW-UP: add a reusable dev/validation quality report to the pilot, correct token-length MCQA normalization, inspect and clean the bilingual clinical mixture, and run only a small controlled comparison after the data/format audit. Do not launch a long run yet.
known_limits: The five-row MCQA dev slice is directional only.
No logit delta was collected in this real-data follow-up; generation movement is sufficient to pass the responsiveness gate, while the independent tiny proof supplies logit/adapter-state evidence.
No frozen final holdout was read, so this record makes no safety promotion claim.
P100 used the naive Mamba implementation; this is representative of the executed training environment but not a claim about an optimized deployment build.

artifacts.local_weight_policy: adapter, optimizer, and model files were not downloaded locally
